name: CVEL Fregat
author: Dave Rowbotham (CVEL)
description: Fregat restartable upper stage with a payload port, as flown on Soyuz and Proton. Converted from the CVEL Orbiter add-on (code and meshes D. Henderson, LGPL). Mass, propellant, thrust and isp from the original; the Orbiter add-on's attitude thrusters are modelled as RCS.
